info.name: BlueConic REST API v2 Audit Events Recommendations API

params.name: profileId
params.description: The ID of the BlueConic profile. Note that the profile ID is required when you use a [recommendation algorithm](https://support.blueconic.com/hc/en-us/articles/360022093313-BlueConic-recommendation-algorithms) that depends on the profile, such as 'Collaborative filtering' or 'Seen articles / Seen products'.

params.name: storeId
params.description: The ID of the content store to get the items from.

params.name: itemId
params.description: ID of the current item being shown. Some algorithms are based on this information. It also excludes this item from being returned in the result.

params.name: frequencyCap
params.description: The number of times an item can be recommended to a profile before being hidden from future recommendations.

params.name: imageWidth
params.description: Width of the images to return.

params.name: imageHeight
params.description: Height of the images to return.

params.name: manualViewCounting
params.description: Prevent updating recommendation statistics for the recommended items. Can be used to generate offline recommendation items without influencing the profile.

items.docs: Generate BlueConic recommendations for a specific profile based on the provided parameters.
